stories.title: Recap — Brewers 9, Cubs 4 (Boyd burned in 6th)
stories.angle: Boyd solid through 5, fell into third-time-through trap in 6th inning; Palencia abysmal in relief; Cubs lose 9-4; record falls to 78-61

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Boyd looked like he'd escaped. The 6th inning said otherwise.

Brewers 9, Cubs 4. Boyd fell into the third-time-through trap in the 6th — Palencia made it worse. Cubs managed just 4 runs against a Milwaukee staff.

Cubs are 78-61. Fix it tonight.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Game 2 Preview — Misiorowski vs. Peterson at Wrigley, 6:40 PM CT
stories.angle: Misiorowski 14-5/1.73 ERA/222 SO leads MLB in ERA, K, WHIP; Peterson (7-7, 5.11) on the hill for Chicago; Cubs must split the 2-game series

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Jacob Misiorowski. 14-5. 1.73 ERA. 222 strikeouts. WHIP of 0.75.

The best pitcher in baseball starts tonight at Wrigley, 6:40 PM CT. David Peterson (7-7, 5.11 ERA) gets the ball for Chicago.

Cubs need a win. Wrigley needs to be loud.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — Cubs 78-61, Cardinals Effectively Eliminated
stories.angle: Cubs hold WC spot at 78-61 with 23 games left; Cardinals ~68-71 and cooked; Phillies also holding a WC; division gap vs Brewers remains ~8 GB

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Cubs are 78-61 with a Wild Card spot. 23 games to close it out.

Cardinals: 68-71. Effectively cooked. Milwaukee ran off and left St. Louis fighting over respectability.

Cubs and Phillies holding WC spots. Win games.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Swanson Swinging + Steele Iowa Rehab This Week
stories.angle: Swanson swung a bat Monday for first time since Aug 17 IL stint; Steele begins Triple-A Iowa rehab assignment this week; two October weapons on track simultaneously

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Dansby Swanson swung a bat for the first time Monday since his Aug. 17 IL stint.

Justin Steele begins his Triple-A Iowa rehab assignment this week.

Two October weapons on the same track. Cubs' postseason ceiling just got a lot higher.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: PCA Closing in on 40-40 / NL MVP Case
stories.angle: .282/.36 HR/32 SB/.944 OPS; 4 HR + 8 SB from 40-40; -1100 MVP favorite; nobody in baseball doing what PCA is doing

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
.282 BA. 36 HR. 32 SB. .944 OPS.

PCA is 4 home runs and 8 stolen bases from a 40-40 season. He's also the -1100 MVP favorite heading into September's final push.

Nobody in baseball is doing what he's doing.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Pre-Game Hype — Cubs vs. the Best Pitcher in Baseball
stories.angle: Misiorowski 14-5/1.73 ERA starts at Wrigley, 6:40 PM CT; Cubs need a response; home crowd as the edge

x_posts.label: Post 6A
x_posts.text:
Misiorowski is 14-5 with a 1.73 ERA. He leads all of baseball.

Cubs have to beat him tonight at Wrigley, 6:40 PM CT. That's the assignment. No excuses, no moral victories.

Wrigley's gonna need to be different tonight. Show up.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
